note: Draft register for Spec 061 (design D-27, arm A1 only, PR #195 packet), opened 2026-10-21 under the runnable-experiments campaign plan approved by the owner AS WRITTEN on 2026-10-21 (Part 2 member 18; decision E-3 governs the excluded arm A2). Conventions as in Specs 032-042: requirement claims carry no falsification test where a gate or inspection is the operative check; boundaries carry the conditions under which each claim holds; evidence items carry observed_at from this draft because the cited facts were verified first-hand at drafting. The AEE lifecycle hooks have NOT run on this register; they are the freeze gate (tasks L4), and any recovery round they force changes claim text before any freeze digest is computed. ASM- ids name the assumptions each claim stands on: ASM-PHASE393-RECORD (Phase-393's recorded results are the record of the frozen test), ASM-PHASE393-MACHINERY (pipeline393.py as pinned is the machinery of record), ASM-MARGIN-FAMILY (the Spec 027/028 family's single 0.01 adjusted-R2 margin), ASM-SCENARIO-VALUES (the design's two stated thetas, 0.00878 and 0.015, and no others), ASM-SIMULATION-NOT-DATA (simulated resamples are a planning instrument, never held data or evidence), ASM-GATES-BEFORE-OUTCOME (pins, reproduction, and the frozen search frame precede any precision quantity), ASM-APPEND-ONLY (outcomes append; frozen records are never edited). FREEZE RECOVERY (2026-10-21): normalised to engine evidence values at 0.6-draft (kind observed, source_quality artifact; refs, descriptions, observed_at unchanged - the draft's free-form labels are not engine values); freeze rulings DD-061-8 to DD-061-15 were carried into the boundaries of F061-C03, C06, C07, C10, C11, C12, and C14 before the hooks ran. At 0.7-draft the 12 irreducibility-challenged claim texts (F061-C04 to C15) were restated as single head propositions with carried clauses moved into boundaries verbatim-in-substance, and every multi-item claim's evidence gained mutual independent_of declarations. A final restatement round over 0.7-draft shortened the four remaining irreducibility-challenged heads (F061-C07, C10, C14, C15) to single propositions, their removed clauses carried into boundaries verbatim-in-substance. F061-C07's head was shortened once more in the same round, its gate-ordering clause carried into its boundary.

claims.text: An outcome under Spec 061 states only the intake target at which Spec 028 Arm A's interval would resolve at the 0.01 margin, computed from Phase-393's recorded resampling distribution under the two stated scenarios.
boundary: The scope is a precision computation on recorded data: Phase-393's Arm A distribution and the recorded site samples behind it. It excludes any statement about the ancient world, about whether site-linked repertoire structure exists, about movement of people, about sign meanings, and about the frozen Arm A verdict, which stands INCONCLUSIVE as recorded.
alternatives: a returned target could be read as evidence the effect is real (it cannot: the computation assumes a scenario theta and measures resolution, it does not estimate theta)
falsification_tests: the claim is falsified in scope if any Spec 061 output states a conclusion about the ancient world, a population, or a question outside the resolution of the recorded Arm A test

boundary: Strict exclusion is DD-061-2: an interval bound equal to 0.01 touches the margin and does not resolve, which differs deliberately from the frozen family's 'entirely at or below' CONTRADICTED wording because the design's word is 'exclude'. The 80% share and the interval construction (percentile interval over a trial's draws, as in Phase-393) are design- and record-fixed. Freeze ruling: DD-061-2 is CONFIRMED as drafted - resolution is strict exclusion in the scenario's direction; a bound equal to 0.01 touches the margin and does not resolve. Carried from the draft text: upper bound below 0.01 under Scenario 1, lower bound above 0.01 under Scenario 2; a grid point qualifies if and only if at least 80% of its trials resolve. Carried from the draft text: a trial resolves if and only if its adjusted-R2 percentile interval excludes 0.01 strictly in its scenario's direction.
